_about: Public-domain U.S. government data series for the podcast's original charts. Fetched from FRED (St. Louis Fed) by scripts/fetch-series.mjs into src/data/series/<id>.csv. Only add series whose original source is a U.S. government agency: FRED also carries copyrighted series (S&P, Nasdaq, ICE, etc.) that must not be used. Commercial data (Ornn H100, DRAMeXchange) stays out until its licence is verified.
